instruction: How to generate an ECDH certificate
output: openssl ecparam -genkey -name secp256r1 -out ecdh-key.pem && openssl req -x509 -new -key ecdh-key.pem -out ecdh-cert.pem -days 365 -subj '/CN=ecdh'

How to sign a CSR with a specific digest
output: openssl x509 -req -sha512 -in req.csr -CA ca.pem -CAkey ca.key -out cert.pem -days 365

instruction: How to create a certificate with a custom serial
output: openssl x509 -req -in req.csr -CA ca.pem -CAkey ca.key -set_serial 12345 -out cert.pem

instruction: How to create a certificate with a random serial
output: openssl x509 -req -in req.csr -CA ca.pem -CAkey ca.key -CAcreateserial -out cert.pem
